info.scriptSrcText: property this, COPTER, nozzleAngle, PrevSpacePressed, ploshDelay, radians, sprayWait, prevgWaterFlow, cableGuyglobal gPaused, gWaterFlow, gPloshList, gPloshXon beginSprite  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  radians = float(PI / 180)  cableGuy = sprite(6)  COPTER = sprite(4)  nozzleAngle = 0  this.locZ = 99  prevgWaterFlow = 0  ploshDelay = 3  sprayWait = 0endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    gPloshX = -1    if keyPressed(123) then      nozzleAngle = nozzleAngle + 6    end if    if keyPressed(124) then      nozzleAngle = nozzleAngle - 6    end if    if keyPressed(49) then      if prevgWaterFlow = 0 then        if sprayWait >= 15 then          puppetSound(3, member(33, "Sfx"))          gWaterFlow = 1          cableGuy.cableState = #GOUP        else          sprayWait = sprayWait + 1        end if      end if    else      sprayWait = 0      gWaterFlow = 0      if prevgWaterFlow = 1 then        puppetSound(3, 0)        PrevSpacePressed = 0      end if    end if    prevgWaterFlow = gWaterFlow    nozzleAngle = nozzleAngle * 0.94999999999999996    this.rotation = nozzleAngle    this.locH = COPTER.locH    this.locV = COPTER.locV + 10    if gWaterFlow = 1 then      ploshDelay = ploshDelay + 1      if ploshDelay >= 3 then        if gPloshList.count > 0 then          gPloshList[1].ploshState = #PLOSH          gPloshList[1].Xvel = 8 * sin(-nozzleAngle * radians)          gPloshList[1].Yvel = 8 * cos(-nozzleAngle * radians)          gPloshList[1].Xpos = this.locH          gPloshList[1].Ypos = this.locV          gPloshList[1].rotation = nozzleAngle          gPloshList.deleteAt(1)        end if        ploshDelay = 0      end if    else      ploshDelay = 3    end if  end ifend
